verdict.rationale: Weave ships official SDKs (Python and TypeScript) with weave.op() decorators/wrappers, a Service REST API, OpenAPI spec, and OTel-compatible ingestion, giving AI-native developers multiple official, documented ways to build against it, plus GitHub repo corroboration. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarks or hands-on developer reviews validating SDK ergonomics beyond first-party docs.
